        // how long the user is idle for before it trigers the prompt message about conversation is going to be cleared.
        let ambitTimestampTimeout = 180000;
        // timeout for warning message (ie 30 seconds BEFORE removing conversation)
        let offsetTimeForWarning = 30000;
        let warningTime = ambitTimestampTimeout - offsetTimeForWarning;
        let time;
        
        /**
         * to check if the timeoutNumber is elapsed, if so, reset conversation, otherwise update the timeout.

        function activateEventHandlers() {
          window.onload = resetTimer;
          window.onmousemove = resetTimer;
          window.onkeypress = resetTimer;
          window.onmousewheel = resetTimer;
        }
      
        /**

         **/
        function resetTimer() {
          clearTimeout(time);
          time = setTimeout(checkTimestamp, warningTime);
          updateAmbitTimestamp();

        /**

        function changeConversation(scriptId, nodeId) {
            window.Ambit('jumpToNode', {scriptId: scriptId, nodeId: nodeId});
        }
        
        /**
         * checks if elapsed time since last conversation (ambitTimestamp) is longer than timeoutNumber
         */
        function checkTimestamp() {
          let timeout = localStorage.getItem('ambitTimestamp');
          // check for legacy users
          if (timeout == null) {
            resetAmbitId();
            changeConversation(1,145);
          } else {
            let timeCheck = Date.now() - timeout;
            // check timeout
            if (timeCheck >= ambitTimestampTimeout) {
                resetAmbitId();
                updateAmbitTimestamp();
                changeConversation(1,184);
            }
            else {
                if (timeCheck >= warningTime) {
                    //go to warning message
                    changeConversation(1,183);
                    //reset timer for warning message;
                    clearTimeout(time);
                    time = setTimeout(checkTimestamp, offsetTimeForWarning);
                }
            }
          }
        }
        
        /**
         * updates AmbitTimestamp
         */
        function updateAmbitTimestamp() {
          localStorage.setItem('ambitTimestamp', Date.now());
        }
        
        /**
         * Removes the prior ambit conversation to force a new conversation
         */
        function resetAmbitId() {
          // Clear the messages from the Webchat widget panel
          window.Ambit('clearHistory');
          window.Ambit('closeChatPanel');
        }
        
        window.onload = activateEventHandlers();
        window.onload = checkTimestamp();
